decision_rationale: The paper presents a multimodal LLM architecture and fine-tunes a Llama backbone for QA over genomic, protein-sequence, and structure inputs. The evidence also shows pretrained foundation models and broad pretraining/transfer use across modalities.
evidence_snippet: “multimodal large language model” and “Llama 33 model itself, were fine-tuned jointly”; “weights of the original foundation models ... remained frozen”
